claim: In India, FSSAI certification is the mandatory license for manufacturing or selling nutraceutical products, and operating without it is illegal under FSS Act 2006.
stance_target: FSSAI regulatory compliance is required for all nutraceutical brands selling in India
quoted_support: Manufacturing or selling nutraceutical products without the GMP or FSSAI registration can lead to many issues, like illegal and serious penalties. It's a compulsory thing to have these certifications before entering in Indian market with your nutraceutical products.
entities: Food Safety and Standards Authority of India

claim: GMP certification for nutraceutical products in India is issued by FSSAI under the Food Safety and Standards Act 2006.
stance_target: FSSAI is the relevant certification body for Indian nutraceutical GMP
quoted_support: The certification is issued by the Food Safety and Standards Authority of India (FSSAI) under the Food Safety and Standards Act, 2006.

claim: GMP certification for nutraceuticals requires compliance with the Food Safety and Standards (Health Supplements, Nutraceuticals, etc.) Regulations 2016.
stance_target: Regulatory framework for nutraceutical quality in India
quoted_support: Complying with the Food Safety and Standards (Health Supplements, Nutraceuticals, etc.) Regulations, 2016, are an important thing if you are a manufacturer in India.

claim: GMP certification for exports from India also serves as a mandatory requirement for entering global markets.
stance_target: GMP certification value for Indian supplement brands seeking international distribution
quoted_support: if you want to trade internationally, then the GMP certification is also a mandatory thing for entering global markets.
